issues.body:
Unchanged since round 1. The banner says 'The Pages cutover discussed below is complete' and that 'future-tense cutover steps below are retained as historical retirement criteria'. The cutover this record discusses is not the sq-iigf source-mode flip; it is the step at lines 79-81: repoint the bench.yml seed step / benchmark-data publishing at the site export - '**This is the actual retirement step**; the standalone UI files come out only here.' That has not happened at this head: .github/workflows/bench.yml:630 still sets `benchmark-data-dir-path: dev/bench`, and :722 still copies the standalone dashboard UI into dev/bench/ and pushes when it is missing or differs. .github/workflows/pages.yml:26 states it 'does NOT touch the benchmark-data branch - bench.yml keeps' writing it, and its 'Overlay benchmark dashboard(s) (dev/bench*) from benchmark-data' step (:266) git-archives that tree into out/dev/. So bench.yml still owns the seed and the standalone bench/dashboard/ files are still the live served artifact - exactly the condition the record's DO-NOT-RETIRE verdict rests on.

Note one narrowing versus round 1: the two MAJOR chart gaps at lines 71-74 HAVE since closed (site/src/components/benchmarks/trend-charts.tsx, scaling-charts.tsx, line-chart.tsx exist; sync-benchmarks.mjs emits a 20-commit `history` window per sq-hsyg). Those specific bullets are genuinely satisfied. The cutover bullet at 79-81 is not, and it is the one the retirement gate turns on. Labelling it 'historical' inverts the verdict and could lead a future agent to delete bench/dashboard/ and take the published dashboard down.
issues.fix_hint: Scope the banner to what actually completed, and be specific about what did not. For example: 'The separate sq-iigf Pages *source-mode* cutover (branch-served -> Actions producer) is done repo-side and its runbook has been rewritten as a topology/provenance record. The in-site trend and scaling chart gaps below have since closed (sq-hsyg). The Pages cutover named in this record's Verdict - repointing the bench.yml seed step / benchmark-data publishing at the site export - is still OPEN, so the retirement criteria below remain live.' Drop the 'historical retirement criteria' sentence entirely.
issues.title: Banner declares complete a cutover this record's own verdict names as the still-pending retirement step

issues.body: Unchanged since round 1. The banner says 'references below to a pending Pages mount are retained as historical analysis'. Section 8 at line 190 calls the Pages mount 'The one genuinely blocked item ... a product decision, not a settings flip', and that is still true at this head: .github/workflows/docs.yml still carries the 'WHY IT DOES NOT DEPLOY TO PAGES' block, still says at :22 'When the cutover bead lands, this lane gains the deploy job (configure-pages + upload-pages-artifact + deploy-pages, all SHA-pinned)', and at :112 uploads the rendered guide as 'CI artifact only - NOT a Pages deploy'. .github/workflows/pages.yml:43-44 correspondingly says the mdBook guide 'wants a published home too; until that root question is decided (guide at /guide subpath vs at root ...)'. The guide is not mounted and the root question is undecided. Describing the analysis as historical suppresses an open blocker and the /guide-subpath product decision it frames - the same failure mode #5545 was filed to fix, in the opposite direction.
issues.fix_hint: Reword to distinguish the two cutovers: the sq-iigf source-mode cutover completed and its runbook was rewritten; the guide's Pages mount discussed in section 8 remains OPEN (docs.yml still ships no deploy job; the guide-at-root vs /guide-subpath question is still undecided per pages.yml). Remove the 'historical analysis' framing, or restrict it explicitly to the pre-cutover source-mode statements it truly applies to.
issues.title: Banner calls the pending Pages mount 'historical analysis', but the mount is still blocked in-repo

issues.body: Unchanged since round 1. docs/pages-cutover-runbook.md:9-12 is explicit that the cutover is done 'on the repo side' - 'the producer exists and every prerequisite the original document' named is met - while 'The matching Pages service setting is reported as flipped but is not verified by this document; see Provenance.' Its Provenance section (:18) separates artifact-shape claims (established by workflow source) from service-setting claims (relayed from an undated pages.yml comment). Both new banners assert unqualified completion, re-introducing precisely the overclaim the runbook rewrite was written to remove. The identical wording appears in research/dashboard-retirement-assessment.md, so fix both.
issues.fix_hint: In both banners, say 'complete on the repo side (the producer workflow exists); the Pages service setting is reported flipped but is not verified - see the runbook's Provenance section' rather than a bare 'is complete'.
issues.title: 'Complete' drops the hedge the linked runbook deliberately makes about the unverified Pages service setting

verdict.summary:
Docs-only PR adding a 'Post-record status' banner to two research records asserting 'The Pages cutover is complete'. Since round 1 the ONLY change is commit 21549c89, which deleted one blank line from each file (a CI/formatting repair). The banner prose is byte-identical to round 1, so all three round-1 findings persist unaddressed at their original severities: stagnant, not improving.

Re-verified at this head:
(1) dashboard-retirement-assessment.md still lists the 'Pages cutover' at lines 79-81 as '**This is the actual retirement step**' - repointing the bench.yml seed step / benchmark-data publishing at the site export. That has NOT happened: .github/workflows/bench.yml:630 still sets benchmark-data-dir-path: dev/bench and :722 still seeds the standalone dashboard.js into dev/bench and pushes; .github/workflows/pages.yml:26 states it 'does NOT touch the benchmark-data branch - bench.yml keeps' writing it, and :266 git-archives that tree into out/dev/ as an overlay. The standalone bench/dashboard/ is still the live served artifact, exactly as the record's DO-NOT-RETIRE verdict warns. Calling those criteria 'historical' inverts that verdict.
(2) docs-site-single-sourcing-anti-drift.md section 8 line 190 still reads 'The one genuinely blocked item is the Pages mount ... a product decision, not a settings flip'. Still true: docs.yml:22 says 'When the cutover bead lands, this lane gains the deploy job' and :112 uploads the guide as 'CI artifact only - NOT a Pages deploy'. The mount is not built; 'historical analysis' suppresses a live blocker.
(3) The linked runbook (docs/pages-cutover-runbook.md:9-12) is deliberately hedged - done 'on the repo side', while the Pages 'setting is reported as flipped but is not verified by this document'. Both banners assert bare 'is complete', dropping the hedge.
